description: Updates from the Capitol Hey District 33! It’s hard to believe but this whirlwind session is coming to an end. I anticipate that the 112th General Assembly will conclude this week. We’ve fought hard, stayed the course, and had some major wins. I look forward to finishing out this session strong. Before we close out for the summer, the Senate will vote on TISA, Governor Lee’s new proposed education funding formula.
